description: One CPU teaching run; neither a quality success nor a hardware benchmark.
limitations: Small synthetic template-held-out dataset, not real support tickets.
One generation pass per artifact; timings are not a repeated steady-state comparison.
Byte tokens are not comparable with the pretrained model's tokenizer tokens.
Only linear-layer weights are INT8; other weights and attention arithmetic are not.
Serialized model bytes exclude optimizer state, process memory, and runtime allocations.
Raw results and traces stay outside Git; this file contains selected non-private measurements.
